fields.Name: T144 - Lists Create and Populate
fields.Description: Verifies that a new list can be created in the Lists app for the Members entity and that at least one Member record can be added to it and shown in the list.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Lists app using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box). In the Lists section, use the Create list action to create a new list named 'Regression Test List 2' for the Members entity — when choosing the entity for the list, select the one named exactly 'Members' (NOT 'Memberships', 'Membership Types', or any other Member-prefixed entity). Then add at least one Member record to the list. Confirm success by reaching a state where the new list 'Regression Test List 2' exists and displays the added Member record. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained env - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A list named 'Regression Test List 2' was created for the Members entity
At least one Member record has been added to the list
The list view displays the added Member record (a populated row, not an empty list)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
